thread:
Amanda L.: Heads-up — Newark municipal team signed NDA and wants a 2‑week POC next week. Procurement expects a cost estimate + SLA language by EOD Fri.
Jenna K. (AE): Thanks. Their POC scope: 3 services, ~50k tokens/day, and SSO + KMS for secrets. They asked for 99.9% uptime SLA.
Raj Patel: Do we have a quick cost model for that footprint on Dedicated vs Hosted? 
Derek M. (Eng): Quick back-of-envelope: Hosted with standard latency tier ~ $4.8k/mo. Dedicated reserve would be higher upfront (commit + GPU pool) — probably $12k/mo committed. Need actual perf profile to pick.
Jenna K. (AE): They specifically asked if we can give a monthly cap and an option to fall back to a cheaper model variant during off-hours.
Priya K. (Sec): Security asks: PCI not required but they need KMS integration (customer-managed keys), audit logs, and VPC peering. Also want an incoming data residency attestation for data staying in NJ region.
Amanda L.: Procurement also flagged indemnity language and SLA credits. They want a template to show to legal. Can we provide a redline by Monday?
Derek M. (Eng): @Priya K. — VPC peering + CMK is supported for Private deployments. For Hosted, CMK is still possible via partner KMS but needs security review. VPC peering will be an extra ops step.
Priya K. (Sec): I'll draft a security summary. ETA: tomorrow noon. It will include KMS model, audit retention, and network requirements.
Raj Patel: For pricing I can send a mini-model. Need two numbers: estimated monthly run cost and a capped POC package price that covers spikes.
Derek M. (Eng): For the capped POC package, we can structure as: 
``nPOC package: $15,000 flat for 2 weeks (covers up to 200k tokens/day peak), add-on per-token overage at $0.0006/token
```
This buys them dedicated burst capacity and support.
Jenna K. (AE): That sounds reasonable. Procurement will push for lower cap — can we offer a smaller cap + discount if they commit to 3mo afterwards?
Amanda L.: Good idea. Offer: $12k for 2 weeks if commit to 3 months after POC at reserved price. Include an auto-fallback to Hosted cheaper variant at <24hr notice.
Priya K. (Sec): Note: Any offering with CMK + VPC peering triggers our on-boarding security checklist (network review + pen test window). That adds ~5 business days. Must call out in schedule.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: new private-onboarding-runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-onboard-1789
Raj Patel: I'll draft the pricing email and send to the thread for sign-off.
Amanda L.: Action items: 
- Raj to send pricing + capped offer (today EOD)
- Priya to send security summary (tomorrow noon)
- Derek to confirm feasibility of dedicated burst for that region and provide estimated latency numbers (tomorrow EOD)
- Jenna to prep procurement template and legal redline ask (Monday)
Amanda L.: If we can get these by Monday, I'll join a C-level call with them Tue morning. :thumbsup:
Jenna K. (AE): Noted. I'll coordinate calendar.
Derek M. (Eng): One more tech note — if they want prefix caching for prompts, we should enable KV cache on the model; reduces tokens by ~20% on repetitive workloads. Will include numbers in my note.
Priya K. (Sec): Adding: data residency attestation will be "support for region-restricted processing"; we can provide SOC report excerpts.
Amanda L.: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here.
